title: Not the best design for me
text: Not the best design for me. I’m not a fan of the handles of this silverware set, they curl backward making it very awkward for me to hold. I see why they did it depending on how you probably hold it but even holding it more horizontally seems foreign. They are a cheap set for sure, very light weight and not as polished edges as more expensive sets.
